target.statement: Leiden (CPM) with adaptation achieves F-score 95.522% (PPV 95.933%, SEN 95.115%) on the NHLS HIV cohort, a 36.8% reduction in linkage error vs transitive closure
target.dataset: NHLS HIV cohort (6.9M record edge list)

compute.basis: Requires the de-identified 6.9M-record NHLS edge list (not public, ethics-restricted) plus reimplementing center/merge-center/weighted-diameter from pseudocode and tuning Leiden/CPM parameters; the paper reports ~2 min per Leiden run on 4 cores/32GB but the graph is multi-GB and the full tuning sweep plus 5-run averaging dominates.

blockers: NHLS HIV cohort edge list is confidential/ethics-restricted, not downloadable
No code repository linked in the paper
Synthetic 7M dataset also not publicly available (only generator code)
Weighted diameter code only from authors; center/merge-center only pseudocode
title: Probabilistic linkage with graphs: leveraging cluster structure to improve the accuracy of entity resolution at scale
